recommendation.reason: The best finding-kind accuracy (the only reliable question) is 1.000 (Liquid d1.2-ultra). The chosen default is `Perplexity Decider v1.3 (free)` at $0.000000 per 1,000 items and 2.253 s mean latency. The best model is +0.087 above it (95% bootstrap interval [+0.000, +0.227]), so the two are statistically indistinguishable. `Liquid d1.2-ultra` is the paid alternative with the highest finding-kind accuracy (1.000) and all-question micro 0.573, but it costs $0.200450 per 1,000 and buys no clear accuracy gain.  The ranking is 23 reviewer findings, so its interval is wide; `label_ok` is descriptive only because its reference is defective until T31/v2.1.  This is a reviewer-finding sorter, not a general label-audit gate.
